primary_metric.label: client_js_bytes
primary_metric.description: Total uncompressed JavaScript bytes in the production client bundle (dist/assets/*.js, excluding server.mjs)
primary_metric.noise_band_note: Deterministic output from Vite/Rollup — identical builds produce identical byte counts

attributable_stages.label: vendor_libs
attributable_stages.description: Third-party dependencies (react, radix, transformers, onnxruntime, typegpu, jszip, motion, zustand, tanstack-query)

attributable_stages.label: app_code
attributable_stages.description: Olive Studio application logic (index, pipelineStore, AssistantSidebar, panels)

guardrails.label: bundle_regression
guardrails.check: client_js_bytes must not INCREASE by more than 500 bytes without justification

reward_hack_guards.label: no_feature_removal
reward_hack_guards.description: Bundle size reduction must not come from removing used features or functionality. All existing e2e tests and component tests must continue passing.

reward_hack_guards.label: no_lazy_to_eager
reward_hack_guards.description: Moving code from lazy chunks to fewer eager chunks can reduce total size via dedup but hurts initial load. Chunk count must stay >= 25.

reward_hack_guards.label: gzip_correlation
reward_hack_guards.description: client_gz_bytes must decrease proportionally. A win on raw bytes that inflates gzip (e.g. replacing repeated patterns with random) is a hack.

reward_hack_guards.label: no_minification_tricks
reward_hack_guards.description: Rewriting readable code into unreadable one-liners that happen to minify smaller is not a real optimization. Source readability is preserved.

canary.method: Inject ~100 bytes into OLIVE_VERSION string literal (a used export), verify bundle grows by ~98 bytes, then restore and verify exact baseline recovery

optimization_targets.label: dead_code_elimination
optimization_targets.description: Find and remove unused exports, unreachable branches, and development-only code that leaks into production bundles

optimization_targets.label: dependency_pruning
optimization_targets.description: Replace heavy dependencies with lighter alternatives or native APIs (e.g. uuid with crypto.randomUUID, lodash utils with native)

optimization_targets.label: code_splitting
optimization_targets.description: Move rarely-used panels behind lazy() boundaries to reduce initial bundle

optimization_targets.label: tree_shaking_barriers
optimization_targets.description: Fix barrel re-exports, side-effect markers, and dynamic imports that prevent effective tree-shaking

optimization_targets.label: duplicate_logic
optimization_targets.description: Consolidate repeated utility implementations across modules
